Project **myraa** is a **polyglot** application (TypeScript) on branch 'main'.
Frameworks/Tools: React, Vite, Express, Electron, TailwindCSS, Google GenAI, Three.js.
Scale: 261 files across 65 directories.
Key Layers: Frontend UI & Interaction; Backend Gateway & Core Engine; Cognitive Memory & Project Intelligence; Desktop Control Agent.
Entry Points: server.ts, src/main.tsx, src/app.tsx, index.html, desktop_agent/main.py, electron/main.cjs.

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable

layers.name: Frontend UI & Interaction
layers.description: Interactive visual interfaces, HUDs, and components.

layers.name: Backend Gateway & Core Engine

layers.name: Cognitive Memory & Project Intelligence

layers.name: Desktop Control Agent

keyComponents.name: MemoryManager
keyComponents.purpose: Structured persistent memory and context ranking
